a:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Strict side view for a 2D side-scrolling game, the camera is level with the ground (not from above). Characters face RIGHT.
Tiles and background layers marked "connect seamlessly" must match exactly at the LEFT and RIGHT edges so they can repeat.
Mid layers: draw only the lower part, leave the upper part empty flat #FF00FF magenta.

MELODY QUEEN: a porcelain BALLERINA figurine who lives on top of an ornate wooden MUSIC BOX (rose-pink #E8A0A8 box with gold #F2C14E trim and a mirror inside the lid).
Cream porcelain skin, a pink tutu, a small gold tiara, rubber hose arms and legs with white gloves and pink ballet shoes.
A big SILVER wind-up key on her back. Graceful and elegant, but when overwound she trembles on tiptoe with spiral dizzy eyes and a forced smile.
About twice BOGLE's height including the music box. Sad and frightened rather than evil.

Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite sheet. Reference 1 is the primary line and palette anchor. Reference 2 is drawing technique ONLY, never copy its cup-head character or lettering. Reference 3 is boss scale/outline consistency ONLY. Original porcelain ballerina character. Keep the same face, tiara, tutu, silver back key and rose wooden music box across all poses. IMPORTANT JOB-SPECIFIC OVERRIDES: all boss poses face LEFT despite generic RIGHT rule; overwound eyes are SPIRALS, not pie eyes. Level side-scrolling camera. No human anatomy joints, no anime eyes, no copied reference characters. Pure solid #FF00FF background throughout all gaps including enclosed spaces. No labels, numbers, palette chips or ground shadows. Full artwork with generous empty margins; all ornaments and effects stay near their own figure and away from neighboring cells.

Create exactly FOUR full-body sprites in ONE horizontal row, left to right idle, wave, spin, rain. Wide landscape sheet, target 3072x1024, equal separate cells with ample magenta gutters. Each full sprite including box at least 600px high. Every pose faces LEFT, shows her music box below her feet and large silver key attached on her back to screen RIGHT. All four have spiral eyes, forced strained smile, trembling lines; elegant and pitiable, never sinister. Wave spreads both arms with a compact ring of notes; spin shows rapid rotating tutu with compact note whirlwind; rain raises both arms with a few metal comb teeth falling above within its own cell. Keep all four music boxes and figurines similarly scaled, open lid mirror behind.

MELODY QUEEN standing on her music box stage facing LEFT, on tiptoe, trembling, spiral dizzy eyes, a forced wide smile, her big silver wind-up key on her back wound so tight it glows

MELODY QUEEN facing LEFT with both arms flung wide, a powerful ring of music notes and sound waves bursting from her, the music box lid open behind her, eyes spinning

MELODY QUEEN spinning extremely fast like a top facing LEFT, her tutu a blur, a small whirlwind of sharp music notes around her feet

MELODY QUEEN facing LEFT raising both arms to the sky, metal music box comb teeth falling from above, her face strained

MELODY QUEEN frozen mid-pose facing LEFT, stiff and trembling, small cracks of strain lines and steam puffs, her big silver wind-up key on her back clearly visible on the right side, painful but cartoonish

MELODY QUEEN sitting calmly on the edge of her music box facing LEFT, legs dangling, normal pie-cut eyes, a soft tired smile, hands on her knees
